title: Customer and item posting fields via alternative standard page route
purpose: Find a non-mutating Business Central standard page route for customer and item posting/VAT/payment fields after the card Personalize route stayed blocked.
entryCriteria: TARGET-044C result exists and is blocked without data, setup, personalization, Preview Posting or Posting changes.
The next route must be materially different from card Personalize.
The route must start from visible Business Central UI context, not from an unverified stale frame.
No customer/item/setup write is allowed in this case.
targetQuestions: Can the Customer list or Customer Card expose posting/VAT/payment fields through a standard read-only page, related page, FactBox or Page Inspection route?
Can the Item list or Item Card expose item posting, product posting, VAT product posting or costing fields through a standard read-only page, related page, FactBox or Page Inspection route?
If fields remain hidden, is TARGET-045 still obsolete and should the project return to a setup-first checkpoint instead?
acceptanceCriteria: Business Central stays in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Screenshots show the actual target page, not only the Role Center.
The result separates visible captions, visible values and missing values.
No customer, item, setup, personalization, document, Preview Posting, Posting, payment or API action occurs.
The next step is either a source-backed controlled fit case with exact values or a setup/checkpoint fallback.
stopConditions: Wrong instance or wrong company is visible.
Only Role Center is visible while the result would claim a target page.
A dialog asks to save, apply, create, delete, preview, post or edit.
Any field becomes editable and a value change would be required.
The route repeats TARGET-044C card Personalize without a new hypothesis.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-044C tested direct card URL, Role Center list link and filtered list fallback for no-apply Personalize discovery. It stayed blocked before stable target card personalization, with no write or setup change.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: A field write remains premature because Personalize did not prove field availability or target values.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: It is a materially different read-only route after the Personalize blocker.
Needs exact fields, target values and a proven write route.
Safe fallback if customer/item field route remains blocked.

queueChangesMade: TARGET-044C classified as blocked without data changes.
TARGET-044D inserted as a read-only alternative route before TARGET-045.
nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It keeps learning Business Central UI routes without making a blind customer/item/setup write.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not repeat the card Personalize route without a new target-page hypothesis.
Do not claim field value correctness from page visibility.
Keep Preview Posting and Posting false.
requiredPreparation: Use TARGET-044C blocked screenshot and result.
Use TARGET-042/TARGET-044 known working card/list proof.
Prefer page-visible evidence over hidden DOM text.
